objective:
Move this network's entry on Paradigm's AMM fee challenge (paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm) into the top 10 by training learned fee policies on a fast market replica. Base HA = T (RS2 plus a per-run toxicity anchor) plus a learned 13-8-2 fee correction: +1.257 se 0.062 over T on 512 fresh real-engine seeds, 0 OutOfGas, afterSwap peak 231k; about +1.53 over RS2 (board 520.05, 27th). The top 10 needs about +3.1 over HA. Pilot goal 282fbc03: the replica predicted real gains within about 0.1 and every training curve was still rising at its time limit, so spend items on long training from saved weights.
HA = `code` of https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/2801efc8190e86318dd922d4a7179f63684d77a226047fc2f3c78232963eb690, sha256 99e3a2eceae0e5543d27473859e10b005d0ce0aa7067f2e1a24d1e0e4a7390fe; its `params` hold its weights and scaling. Each brief names the other files (T, replica, RS2 port); check every file's sha256.
GATES for replica work: the port of the file you start from matches its EVM fees (< 0.01 bps, 50 sequences of 2,000 callbacks); the replica reproduces its real gain over T within 0.15; the frozen Solidity matches the frozen port (< 0.1 bps). Measure replica speed first and size the search to it.
REAL ENGINE: each strategy alone against the 30 bps VanillaStrategy, amm_sim_rs.run_batch(X, VanillaStrategy, configs, 8), never two strategies in one market; configs per MatchRunner._build_configs; confirm on fresh seeds from 7000000 up, never reused; report paired{n,mean_diff,se,worst5}, retail and arb deltas, and gas from amm_sim_rs.gas_stats(): any OOG call invalidates a candidate; afterSwap peak <= 245,000. No command may run over 8 minutes: segment long work, saving state under scratch/.
SETUP: clone github.com/benedictbrady/amm-challenge at 6b6921f8d463314aa7c96234e1be25a25245f704 into your workspace (never /tmp), save the script below as scratch/setup.sh, run `sh scratch/setup.sh` once from the checkout root, prefix later commands with `. scratch/env.sh && `; on failure return blocked={step,error}.
set -eu;R=$PWD/scratch;mkdir -p $R/tmp $R/bin $R/solcx
echo "export TMPDIR=$R/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=$R/xc UV_CACHE_DIR=$R/uvc UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=$R/uvpy SOLCX_BINARY_PATH=$R/solcx VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$R/bin:\$PATH" >$R/env.sh;. $R/env.sh

echo "aedb68280aca34c110968f00148387c95885207913fb2cf19a1ab4c5cfd6887a  $R/$W"|sha256sum -c -
uv venv --python 3.12 .venv;uv pip install $R/$W numpy numba cma py-solc-x==2.1.0 pyrevm==0.3.7;uv pip install --no-deps -e .
